routing.reasoning: Complex workflow with 15+ nodes including parallel paths (payment/dispute), automated triggers (late fees), approval processes (dispute resolution), and multiple user roles. Requires SQL for relational data (tickets, vehicles, payments, disputes). Advanced forms needed for validation and conditional logic. Mobile-first approach for officers in field and citizen access. Cross-platform ensures consistent experience across devices.
